# Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust & NDR Schools, Kiratpur

> **Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust** (श्री नारायण दास रस्तोगी चैरिटेबल ट्रस्ट; Established **09 August 1991**, New Delhi) is an irrevocable Indian public charitable trust dedicated to K–12 education, girl child empowerment, clean campus infrastructure, and rural upliftment. In **Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur (District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh – 246731)**, the Trust and its educational society (**Shri Narayandas Rastogi Aadarsh Shiksha Samiti**) operate three recognized educational wings serving students from Primary to High School without taking government grants for over 35 years:
> 1. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Saraswati Shishu Mandir** (Primary Wing — Classes I to V, Basic Shiksha Parishad Permanently Recognized since 1997)
> 2. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Junior High School** (Upper Primary Girls' Wing — Classes VI to VIII, Basic Shiksha Parishad Recognized since 2002)
> 3. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Inter College** (Secondary / High School Wing — Classes IX to X, UP Board Recognized since 2004)

## Institutional Overview & Governance
- **Trust Legal Name:** Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust
- **Year of Establishment:** 1991 (09 August 1991, New Delhi)
- **Legal Character:** Irrevocable Public Charitable Trust
- **Guiding Motto:** *"सेवा ही जीवन है • तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय"* (Service is Life • Lead me from darkness to light)
- **Founder President (1991):** Late Shri R. B. Rastogi (Co-Founders: Late Shri Raj Bahadur Rastogi & Late Shri Satish Chandra Rastogi)
- **Board of Trustees (Apex Governing Body):**
  - **Shri Ravinder Kumar Rastogi** — Senior Founding Trustee (Since 1991)
  - **Shri Subhash Rastogi** — Managing Trustee & Chairman
  - **Shri Vipul Kumar Rastogi** — Trustee & Institutional Modernization Lead
- **Campus Academic Leadership:**
  - **Shri Devendra Singh** — Principal (प्रधानाचार्य), NDR Balika Vidya Mandir Inter College
  - **Dr. Kuldeep Rastogi** — Local Campus Guardian, Kiratpur

## Tier 1 Public Compliance Summary
- **Income Tax Section 12AB:** Active & Verified (Charitable Trust Registration)
- **Income Tax Section 80G:** Active & Verified (50% Tax Deduction Eligible for Donors)
- **Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) Form CSR-1:** Active & Verified (`CSR00117504`)
- **NITI Aayog NGO Darpan Portal:** Registered & Active (`DL/2026/1118189`)
- **State Educational Recognition:** UP Board (Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad) & Basic Shiksha Parishad, U.P.

## Tier 2 Statutory Dossier & Banking Coordinates (On Verified Requirement)
Certified statutory orders (12AB/80G certificates, MCA CSR-1 registration letter, Trust Deeds, UP Board recognition orders, audited statements, and official banking remittance coordinates) are shared directly with verified donors, CSR committees, and regulatory authorities via the website's **Request Statutory Dossier / CSR Pack** portal or via `naraindassrastogicharitabletrust@outlook.com`.
